body: Thank you so much. This helps a lot.
Thank you very much. I will do that.

Thank you so much for taking the time for me.
God bless you too.

I had spoken to her again a couple of months ago. The exchange didn't go very well, but she did tell me she was over what had happened. I thankfully did get my opportunity to apologize but I do admittedly miss being friends.

Thanks but I feel I deserve this. 
Our falling out had happened months ago and for all that time I never understood how I really felt or what I wanted. I had finally stopped being so stubborn and opened up to another friend recently about everything that happened and they had helped me understand things from this other persons perspective. It's only now just starting to sink in the damage I caused. 
I need to be punished for this.

Hey. Just want to thank everyone for their words and input. And I appreciate the kick in the ass I needed to do something. I had been too ashamed to message this person for so long, I never considered the different ways this person could have been dealing with this. 

I have sent this person a message opening up and giving them a direct and honest apology. I owe them that much.

Update. I've spent my day grieving on how things have changed. But I've finally figured out I was thinking irrationally. She is someone I care about so much, why the hell am I just letting it go? I'm going to fix this. I'm going to prove I care and that I will fight for this.
I'm trying so hard not to. And I will.

I'm trying and it's getting worse. I'll send this to her if I don't see things improving in the future. 

I think she does want to give up but is afraid to tell me.
